# TrackIQ

> An Amazon MCP server. It connects Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor to a seller's
> live Amazon data — retail sales, profitability, Sponsored Ads, Amazon DSP,
> Amazon Marketing Cloud, Search Query Performance, organic rank, Best Sellers
> Rank, inventory, promotions, competitors and Vendor Central — through one
> Model Context Protocol connection, plus 30 ready-made Agent Skills that turn
> that data into finished analysis.

One plan at $69/month covering every tool and all 30 skills. Sellers bring
their own Amazon account and their own assistant subscription; authorisation
runs through Amazon's OAuth, so TrackIQ never receives an Amazon password.
Install with `claude mcp add trackiq "https://trackiq.com/mcp"`.

## Product

- [TrackIQ MCP](https://l.trackiq.com): what the MCP connects, what it can act on, and pricing
- [MCP overview](https://trackiq.com/mcp): the server, its tools and how it fits an Amazon account
- [Install](https://trackiq.com/mcp-install): setup for Claude Code, Claude desktop, Claude.ai, ChatGPT and Cursor
- [Docs](https://trackiq.com/mcp-docs): authentication, supported clients, rate limits and data retention
- [Tools](https://trackiq.com/mcp-tools): the tool catalog by category
- [Security](https://trackiq.com/mcp-security): OAuth scope, storage and retention
- [Pricing](https://trackiq.com/mcp-pricing): $69/month, no per-seat or usage fees

## Skills

- [Skill catalog](https://trackiq.com/skills): 30 Agent Skills across six areas
- [Sponsored Ads](https://trackiq.com/skills/amazon-advertising): wasted spend, budget pacing, structure audits, search-term harvesting, branded vs generic search
- [AMC & DSP](https://trackiq.com/skills/amazon-amc-dsp): new-to-brand customers by product and campaign, media mix, DSP performance, conversion lag
- [Search](https://trackiq.com/skills/amazon-search): rank movement, rank readiness, share of shelf, search visibility, category priority keywords
- [Listing](https://trackiq.com/skills/amazon-listing): listing optimisation and monitoring, catalog hygiene, review mining, competitor teardowns
- [Inventory](https://trackiq.com/skills/amazon-inventory): restock priority, demand forecast, excess inventory, stockout impact, inventory-aware ad throttling
- [Operations](https://trackiq.com/skills/amazon-operations): daily and weekly reporting, monthly business review, launch scorecards, sales movers

## Reference

- [Amazon MCP documentation](https://github.com/TrackIQ-HQ/amazon-mcp): tool reference, client setup and example questions
- [Skills source](https://github.com/TrackIQ-HQ/amazon-seller-skills): every skill, open source, MIT licensed
